task.title: Implement typed OpenClaw upstream client
task.summary_zh: 把 OpenClaw adapter 從只 probe health 補成 typed upstream client：capabilities、session list/get/create/cancel、timeout/retry/error mapping；預設仍可 degraded。
acceptance: typed client covers health capabilities sessions list get create cancel
timeouts retries and upstream error mapping are explicit

no broker paper or live execution is enabled by this task
